translations.description: The translation (i18n) files of the project, from one file chosen as the source: every key in every language, the keys that are missing, empty or extra and the placeholders that differ from the source; edit in place, add a language or a key. JSON files (flat or nested) and .properties. The MCP tool 'i18n' lets an AI check the languages or add one.
